days.title: Red Rock Entry & Oak Creek Canyon Switchbacks

notification.title: Road Trip Begins!
notification.message: Departing PHX via I-17 N towards Sedona and Oak Creek Canyon.
notification.speech: Welcome to Arizona. We are departing Phoenix heading north on I-17 toward Sedona.

checkpoints.name: Sedona Red Rock Vistas (Bell Rock Pull-off)

notification.title: Approaching Sedona Red Rocks
notification.message: Target arrival: 4:30 PM. Recommended stop for red rock vistas and photos.
notification.speech: Approaching Sedona on Highway 179. Pull-offs for Bell Rock and Courthouse Butte coming up in two miles.

notification.title: Oak Creek Canyon Switchbacks
notification.message: Target 5:15 PM. Scenic climb on AZ-89A up to Oak Creek Vista overlook.
notification.speech: Ascending Oak Creek Canyon switchbacks. Oak Creek Vista viewpoint will be on your right at the top.

notification.title: Arrival in Flagstaff
notification.message: Arrived in historic Flagstaff. Explore downtown Route 66 and local dining.
notification.speech: Arriving in Flagstaff. Welcome to historic Route 66 and the downtown district.
